claims.value: A 3B parameter long-context instruct model finetuned from Granite-4.1-3B-Base, enhanced with tool calling, instruction following, and chat capabilities via SFT and RLHF.
claims.evidence: Granite-4.1-3B is a 3B parameter long-context instruct model finetuned from Granite-4.1-3B-Base using a combination of open source instruction datasets...
Granite-4.1-3B comes with enhanced tool calling capabilities, enabling seamless integration with external functions and APIs.
Supported Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic, Czech, Italian, Korean, Dutch, and Chinese.
